method: Match all31 report addresses to exact rt_unimpl markers; take the containing function from generated-function-index.tsv line ranges, never a nearest address guess.

Decode matching original bytes with Capstone5.0.9 and scan alternate generated instruction comments for a decoded instruction spanning the gap address or its owner entry. Overlap is evidence of conflicting decode boundaries, not proof one path is unreachable.
Reanalyse fragment entry 0x796870 with tools/recomp/analysis.py and the exact generation boundary file tools/recomp/functions.txt: it records cannot decode at 0x796872.
All function/module names remain inherited hints. Source line ranges identify generated bodies, not certified original function boundaries.
No translator was patched; no game reachability execution was performed.
Generated output incorporates repository translator guards/replacements even without explicit runtime arguments; this audit does not label it a pristine or semantically exact translation.
interpretation: Every reported unhandled instruction belongs to a fragment/false-entry-named generated body. Overlapping byte decodes support investigation of erroneous entry boundaries.
